entries.title: Inscryption
entries.definitive_edition: Inscryption on Windows PC with Kaycee's Mod

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with Kaycee's Mod.

primary.version: Current PC release with Kaycee's Mod
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the complete game plus the official free Kaycee's Mod mini-expansion, with PC capture/settings flexibility. Later Linux, macOS, PlayStation, Switch, and Xbox versions are documented access routes, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Inscryption on Steam, GOG, or Epic for Windows PC, update to the current build, finish the main game, then play Kaycee's Mod from the same install.

all_releases.fidelity: Original native PC release with official Kaycee's Mod expansion available.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The official Kaycee's Mod expansion is available through the PC route; no platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented elsewhere.

entries.remaster_caveats: Kaycee's Mod is an official free mini-expansion, not a separate paid remaster. The earlier Sacrifices Must Be Made prototype is a precursor rather than the definitive release.
